snippet.title: PRISON OF HUSKS - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for PRISON OF HUSKS - a nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity, and explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses. If you're yearning to play, wishlist it now on Steam and try the free demo. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
